meta.title: SceneNav AI — 65-Second Cinematic LinkedIn Launch Film

scenes.purpose: Orbital space view of Earth with satellite signal geometry collapsing under electronic warfare.
scenes.voiceover: In contested domains, satellite navigation is fragile. When electronic warfare blinds GPS, positioning signals vanish into silence.
scenes.textOverlay: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN POSITIONING SIGNALS ARE UNAVAILABLE?
scenes.subBadge: CRITICAL ALERT: GNSS SATELLITE SIGNALS UNAVAILABLE

scenes.purpose: Camera descends through atmosphere; dual 3D floating image planes exhibit extreme scale, orientation, and perspective disparities.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Curiosity and complexity: visual terrain has information, but camera angles collide.
scenes.voiceover: Yet, the Earth still leaves visual clues. Between satellite reconnaissance and airborne sensors, scale, angle, and perspective collide.
scenes.textOverlay: THE WORLD STILL LEAVES VISUAL CLUES.

scenes.purpose: Multi-scale keypoints illuminate; luminous correspondence vectors shoot across space; RANSAC purges geometric outliers.
scenes.voiceover: SceneNav AI bridges the gap. Invariant feature detectors extract distinctive structures, while robust RANSAC filtering eliminates hundreds of geometric outliers.

scenes.purpose: Projective homography warps the optical sensor plane into planar alignment over the satellite reference map; 4 illuminated corner vertices project ground footprint.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Awe and precision: geometric alignment locked.
scenes.voiceover: Through projective homography, the optical camera perspective is mathematically warped and locked onto the reference map, projecting the exact ground footprint.

scenes.purpose: Comprehensive scientific diagnostic matrix: spatial dispersion, condition number, reprojection residual, and heuristic reliability index.
scenes.voiceover: Every fix is rigorously validated. Multi-scale dispersion, inlier geometry, and matrix conditioning inform our heuristic reliability index—safeguarding against false locks.
scenes.disclaimer: * SCIENTIFIC NOTICE: Confidence index is an uncalibrated heuristic metric of internal matching consistency — not an independent probabilistic guarantee of true geographic localization.

scenes.purpose: Dynamic animated 7-stage pipeline rail with travelling energy pulse.
scenes.voiceover: A unified visual navigation pipeline: from raw pixels to verified spatial coordinates, operating entirely without satellite contact.

scenes.purpose: Dark transition; vector lines converge into central SceneNav AI reticle, bold brand identity, and clean hold.
scenes.voiceover: SceneNav AI. Visual intelligence. Spatial understanding. When the sky goes dark, autonomy endures.
